svg.text: maelcum mixer — design v0.3 · switch kills cut at zero crossing (dec. 164) · band-split GROWL and TAPE (dec. 165-166) · LOCKED order: kill → EQ → drive → meter
cuts and reopens at the way's zero crossing (164)
series SVF parametrics (detail on the right)
the 5 EQ bands are NOT the 5 ways
two blends in series on the clean path (dec. 99)
no VCA: dual pots in the signal path
ZOOM — BAND-SPLIT DRIVE: GROWL + TAPE (five-way §5bis REV 2026-11-03, per side)
each knob doses the «difference» signal (saturated minus clean): knob closed, the output is exactly the input
mids: band up to the 2.5 kHz pole
Both fully up, sub and kick reach 52 % and 77 % on the mix: an extreme gesture, accepted (dec. 166e).
LTspice = MC-5WAY model within 0.03 points (todo 234). Module noise fully up: GROWL −78.2, TAPE −79.1,
both −71.1 dBu A-wtd; mid-travel −85.5 / −85.6; knobs closed −85.9 (docs/06 §10). To be heard in MC-5WAY.
ZOOM — SWITCH KILL CUT AT ZERO CROSSING (dec. 88, 164; §8.10-8.11)
series + shunt to GND when off
L and R cut at their own zero
A hard cut, no fade, but no pop in the horns.
Step from −92 dB (SUB) to −44 dB (SUPER) relative to a hard cut.
The kill waits for zero: at most SUB 13.5 ms, KICK 6.3 ms,
MID 2.9 ms, HIGH and SUPER under 0.5 ms. No VCA, hiss unchanged.
To be heard in the MC-5WAY prototype [PROVISIONAL].

g.text: ZOOM — PARAMETRIC CELL v0.2.1 + continuous WIDTH v0.2.2 (JFET VCR, dec. 117)
1 matched dual JFET per cell · core at −12 dBu local (Rvin 40.2k) · ×4 make-up absorbed in the injection · verified: THD 0.005% nom / 0.125% worst, law ±0.03%
JFET in triode = VCR: rds = f(Vcm)
pot θ → law shaper (dec. 70 family: exponential) → Vcm (−1.75…−0.29 V, never positive)
→ gain-2 buffer → Vcm2 bus → 2×100k network per JFET (gate = Vcm + vds/2)
10-turn trim per side/band · L/R tracking: matched pair on one die (≤17 cents over ±10 °C)
WIDTH: continuous knob Q3…Q0.3, dual 1k pot
GAIN: linear pot + law resistors (dec. 129 B2): boost
uniform up to +15, full notch in the last degrees

svg.text: Why no LM13700 OTAs in the cells: structural 52 mV state ceiling at f0 → the bare cell collapsed (THD 3-6 %).
The JFET VCR is a controlled resistor: core at −12 dBu local, THD 0.005 % nominal / 0.125 % worst — soft, drive territory.
THAT 218x / V2181L silicon in the module: none (switch kills, pot drive). Per-cell noise figures from INTEG are invalid.
